brief: Kosovo's private commercial banks publish in Albanian first and English second, and none of them announce technology vendors directly — so this cell's value comes from a layered read rather than any single newsroom. The strongest confirmed direct sources are Raiffeisen Kosovo's paginated Lajmet archive, BKT Kosova's Njoftime page, and the ProCredit Kosovo and NLB Prishtinë annual-report repositories; parent-group disclosure at ProCredit Holding (Pillar 3) and NLB Group IR is materially more explicit about IT structure and Kosovo segment digitalisation than the local entities are. The highest-yield indirect and pointer sources are the Kosovo Banking Association's Payments Forum programme (which names the vendors and speakers no bank site does), app-store release notes and developer identities across the eight banks' mobile apps, and IFI facility announcements such as EBRD's. Main gaps: Ziraat Kosovo's domain is unresolved, TEB has no real newsroom, Serbian-language coverage of these banks appears non-existent, and the Turkish/Austrian parent groups still need a dedicated pass.
